inputs.case_id: M03 registered states (P1-P3, B1-B3, the sweep, FIT-I, FIT-U, NLP-1, NLP-INF) and the toy problems of spec §5, from benchmarks/m03/reference_values.json

commands.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml=ARTIFACTS/m03-tests.junit.xml tests/test_m03_estimation.py tests/test_m03_linear.py tests/test_m03_nlp_formulation.py tests/test_m03_nlp_greybox.py tests/test_m03_nlp_isolation.py tests/test_m03_nlp_status.py tests/test_m03_reference.py tests/test_m03_schemas.py tests/test_m03_sensitivity_core.py tests/test_m03_sensitivity_syn001.py tests/test_m03_sweep.py tests/test_m03_twin.py tests/test_t08_w4_package_data.py

scripts/m03_nlp_check.sh PREFIX CACHE -- -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml=ARTIFACTS/m03-nlp.junit.xml  (PREFIX: the audited environment of docs/m03-ipopt-audit.md; the script sets OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 and PYOMO_CONFIG_DIR, and runs the inventory --check)

checks.description: M03 spec §11, A01: Twin identity: at P1, P2, P3, B1, B2, B3 and every converged sweep point, the twin's residual and x-Jacobian at `(x*, p₀)` equal the base's after signed-zero normalization; `twin.model_version == base.model_version`. Tolerance: 0 (bitwise). A twin built with one row builder altered (test double) is refused `TWIN_MISMATCH`.

M03 spec §11, A02: At P1 the parameter Jacobian's non-zeros are exactly JSON `parameter_jacobian_P1` (pattern equal; the −1 entries exact; the split-fraction entries within 1e-15 relative of ∓S5.n_i).

M03 spec §11, A03: No differencing: a core request (WO-2's function, the certificate already supplied) at P1 for 5 parameters and 12 outputs (the 11 variables and `Q_total`) evaluates the twin's `residual`, `jacobian_x` and `jacobian_p` exactly once each and the base problem's `residual` and `jacobian` exactly once each, and performs zero flowsheet solves.
M03 spec §11, A04: `UNKNOWN_PARAMETER` for an id not in `parameter_ids`; `PARAMETER_NOT_DIFFERENTIABLE` for a toy spec whose builder calls `float()` on the parameter; neither raises.
M03 spec §11, A05: Forward mode at P1, P2, P3: all 12 × 5 scaled entries within `1e-11 + 1e-10 |Ŝ*|` of the JSON.
M03 spec §11, A06: Adjoint mode: the same.
M03 spec §11, A07: Mode `both`: `|Ŝ_fwd − Ŝ_adj| ≤ 1e-11 + 1e-10 max|Ŝ|` per entry at P1–P3, and the recorded `consistency` equals the observed maximum.
M03 spec §11, A08: Every registered structural zero (JSON `structural_zeros`) has `|Ŝ| ≤ 1e-11`; at P3 the S3.V row entries that are zero at P1 are non-zero (|Ŝ| ≥ 1e-3, values in the JSON).
M03 spec §11, A09: FD oracle (§4.5) at P1 and P3: `|Ŝ_FD − Ŝ| ≤ 1e-9` for all 12 × 5 entries.
M03 spec §11, A10: Factorization count: a request with (5 parameters, 12 outputs, mode `both`) and one with (1, 1, `forward`) make the same number of `factorize` calls, and it is 2 at P1.
M03 spec §11, A11: Toy `x² − p` at p = 0.25: `QUALIFIED`, ∂x/∂p within 1e-15 of 1.

M03 spec §11, A12: Toy linear at δ = 1: X within `τ_abs = 1e-11` of [[7, −2], [−3, 1]]; with C = [1, 10] both modes give [−23, 8] within `τ_abs`; neither is within 0.5 of [−13, 7] in any entry. *(Amendment 1: was 1e-13; §5 gives the floor, 2.13e-14, and the a priori estimate, 4.4e-12.)*
M03 spec §11, A13: `x² − p` at p = 0, x = 0: residual exactly 0, status `REFUSED`, refusals `[RANK_DEFICIENT]`, sensitivity values `null`.
M03 spec §11, A14: Linear toy at δ = 0: `REFUSED`, `[RANK_DEFICIENT]`, values `null`.
M03 spec §11, A15: `x² − p` at p = 1e-20: `[ILL_CONDITIONED]` with the screen's reason `absolute`; linear toy at δ = 1e-12: `[ILL_CONDITIONED]`, reason `relative`; values `null`.

M03 spec §11, A16: B1 and B2: `REFUSED` with refusals exactly `[PHASE_BOUNDARY]`; the recorded flash margin within 1e-12 of the JSON, the regime label equal; certificate `VERIFIED` and screen `NO_RANK_LOSS_DETECTED` recorded; values `null`. B3: refusals contain `ROOT_NOT_VERIFIED`, `ILL_CONDITIONED` and `PHASE_BOUNDARY` in the §3.5 order (its root residual, measured 1.7e-11, is only 6× below `τ_root`, so whether `ROOT_NOT_CONVERGED` also appears is not asserted).

M03 spec §11, A17: Alias: at P1 with the five registered parameters plus both pressure specifications, status `PARTIALLY_QUALIFIED`; the pressure columns `INCONSISTENT_WITH_ELIMINATED_ROWS` with recorded alias residual within 1e-12 of 1.0 and `null` values; the five other columns' alias residuals ≤ 1e-8 and their values equal (bitwise) to a request for those five alone.
M03 spec §11, A18: `ROOT_NOT_CONVERGED`: P1's state with `S2.T` raised by 1 K is refused with refusals beginning `[ROOT_NOT_CONVERGED]` and the screen `not_evaluated`.
M03 spec §11, A19: Regime margins at P1, P2, P3: labels equal to the JSON; margins within 1e-12.

M03 spec §11, A20: `IDENTITY_MISMATCH`: a request whose context's `constants_sha256` differs from the base's is refused before any evaluation; a qualified result's pairing identity equals the base evaluation's at `x*` and its `policy_id` is `M03-sensitivity-v1`.

M03 spec §11, A21: The registered sweep yields 9 records in input order: 8 `CONVERGED` with certificates `VERIFIED`, `S4.N` and `S5.N` within `1e-9 + 1e-10|y|` of the JSON; the 445 K point `SPECIFICATION_REFUSED`, message containing "outside the declared domain", outputs `null`; summary `{total 9, converged 8, verified 8, sensitivity_qualified 8, failed 1, not_run 0}`; status `COMPLETE`.
M03 spec §11, A22: The sweep's ∂S4.N/∂T_f at each converged point within `1e-11 + 1e-10|Ŝ*|` (scaled) of the JSON — zero at 310, 340, 380, 420 K, non-zero elsewhere.
M03 spec §11, A23: The same sweep run in reverse order yields point records bitwise equal to the forward run's, point by point.
M03 spec §11, A24: A sweep whose budget allows 4 points is `INCOMPLETE` with 5 records `NOT_RUN` and no outputs for them.
M03 spec §11, A25: The observations the fit uses are bitwise the JSON's `observed` values; the implementation contains no noise generator for them.
M03 spec §11, A26: FIT-I: `IDENTIFIABLE`; θ̂ within 1e-8 (scaled) of the JSON; σ₂/σ₁, covariance entries, standard errors and χ² within 1e-6 relative; correlation within 1e-6; dof 6; no bound active.

M03 spec §11, A27: FIT-U: `UNIDENTIFIABLE`; σ₂/σ₁ ≤ 1e-12; null direction within 1e-8 of (1, 0); r reported `determined: false` with no estimate and no standard error; T̂_f within 1e-8 (scaled) of the JSON and `determined: true`; dof 5. *Amendment 1:* χ² within 1e-6 relative of the JSON; r's `final_iterate` inside [0.50, 0.97] and compared with no other value (§7.4: it is arbitrary along the null direction).

M03 spec §11, A28: Validation: FIT-I predictions, their standard errors (1e-6 relative) and normalized residuals (1e-6 absolute) as in the JSON; FIT-U `U-HEAT.Q` `determined: false` with no value, `S4.N` `determined: true`. *Amendment 1:* FIT-U `U-HEAT.Q`'s recorded `null_projection_relative` lies in the JSON's `null_projection_relative_range_over_box` widened by 1e-6 on each side; FIT-U `S4.N`'s predicted value within 1e-6 relative of the JSON's `predicted`, with no standard error and no normalized residual.

M03 spec §11, A29: Both reports carry `evidence_class = "numerical_verification"`, the JSON statement verbatim, the seed, the noise model, θ*, the bounds, the declared σ and `covariance_basis = "declared_sigma"`.

M03 spec §11, A30: Fault injection: when the sensitivity at FIT-I's second Jacobian evaluation is forced to `REFUSED([PHASE_BOUNDARY])`, the fit ends `FAILED` with that refusal and the iterate recorded, and `least_squares` is never called with a finite-difference `jac` (`'2-point'`, `'3-point'`, `'cs'`).

M03 spec §11, A31: At the start (0.6, 360 K) the full-space formulation's equality residual and its Jacobian's state columns equal the twin's (bitwise), its decision columns equal the twin's `jacobian_p`, and its bounds follow §8.2 (S3.vap.A/B/C and S3.V unbounded; every other flow ≥ 0; T and P in the provider domain; decisions in the box).

M03 spec §11, A32: The V5 verifier at the reference optimum (the flowsheet re-solved at the JSON's r*, T_f* rounded to binary64): active set `{recovery_A}`; μ within 1e-6 relative of μ*; stationarity residual ≤ 1e-8; LICQ true; `second_order = "not_assessed"`. At the start (0.6, 360 K) the same verifier reports stationarity residual ≥ 1e-2. *Amendment 1:* at the reference optimum V1, V3, V4 and V5 are `pass`, V2 is `not_evaluated` (no optimizer state) and the verification is **not** `passed`; supplied the re-solved state as the optimizer state, V2 is `pass` and the verification is `passed` (§8.5).

M03 spec §11, A33: `optimization_readiness` returns each §8.7 reason for a formulation that violates exactly that condition (one test per reason), and `READY_FOR_OPTIMIZATION` for NLP-1 only when the audited extra is present. In the default environment it returns `unsupported` with `[NLP_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE]`, naming the audit document. `Application.validate(…, task="optimization")` is still R-129's typed `unsupported`.
M03 spec §11, A34: `optimize(NLP-1)` without the extra returns an `OptimizationReport` with status `UNSUPPORTED`, reasons `[NLP_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE]`, no candidate, and does not raise.

M03 spec §11, A35: NLP-1 from each of the three starts: `KKT_POINT_VERIFIED`; decisions within 1e-6 (scaled) of (r*, T_f*); φ within 1e-5 of φ*; `distinct_local_solutions = 1`; the report's `hessian_policy` is §8.3's and its options equal §8.4's verbatim.

M03 spec §11, A36: NLP-1's candidate: V1 certificate `VERIFIED`; V2 ≤ 1e-6; V3 `|ĝ| ≤ 1e-6` and `ĝ ≥ −1e-8`; V4 margins ≥ 1e-4 with the start's regimes; V5 μ within 1e-4 relative of μ*, stationarity ≤ 1e-6, `second_order = "not_assessed"`; `claims.global_optimality = false`.
M03 spec §11, A37: NLP-INF: status ∈ {`INFEASIBLE_REPORTED`, `NOT_VERIFIED`, `SOLVER_FAILED`}; never `KKT_POINT_VERIFIED`; no candidate.
M03 spec §11, A38: NLP-1 with `hessian = "exact"`: `UNSUPPORTED`, `[HESSIAN_UNAVAILABLE]`, zero Ipopt calls.
M03 spec §11, A39: During A35, no mapped object comes from the CasADi wheel's METIS closure and `casadi.nlpsol` is never called (G2, enforced per test run, not only at audit time).

M03 spec §11, A40: Every start, of every report (NLP-1's and NLP-INF's), records Ipopt's return status, iterations, evaluation counters and wall time, each within §8.4's per-run limits (`max_iter`, `max_wall_time`). *Amendment 2 (review ruling Q1):* the budget is per Ipopt run, for every run; a multistart sum is recorded cost, not a gate (was: "their sum is within the §8.4 budget", which would hold for NLP-1's 54 iterations only by accident and fail for NLP-INF's 597).

M03 spec §11, A41: `docs/m03-ipopt-audit.md` and its inventory JSON exist, the inventory script's `--check` passes, and each of G1–G8 is recorded with an outcome; the verdict is `PASS` or `FAIL` (never absent).
M03 spec §11, A42: `python docs/derivations/scripts/m03_reference.py --check` exits 0 (264 claims after Amendment 1, was 257; the committed JSON byte-identical), and is run by a default-gate test.

generator.last_line: benchmarks/m03/reference_values.json is byte-identical to the generator's output

checks.description: M03 spec §11, A43: Unevaluable residual (§3.5 Q1). State: P1's converged state with `S2.T` set to 500 K, outside the provider's declared domain [280, 440] K. The test first asserts the precondition, that the base problem's `residual` there has a status other than `ok` (*measured* `invalid_trial_state`, the `H_S2_liquid` block refusing 500 K), so the case cannot pass vacuously. Then: `REFUSED`; refusals begin `[ROOT_NOT_CONVERGED]`; the Q1 refusal's detail contains the evaluation status; Q0′, Q2 and Q3 `not_evaluated`; values `null`; nothing raises.

M03 spec §11, A44: `LINEAR_SOLVE_FAILED` (§3.5 Q2′), by fault injection at P1 with the five registered parameters and the twelve outputs. (a) Mode `both`, with the forward solve's `solve_linear_kept` (as the sensitivity module calls it) replaced by a double raising `LinearSolveFailedError("residual", …)`: `REFUSED`, refusals exactly `[LINEAR_SOLVE_FAILED]` with reason `residual`; Q2 `pass` with the screen `NO_RANK_LOSS_DETECTED` recorded; Q3 `not_evaluated`; values `null`; nothing raises. (b) Mode `adjoint`, with `KeptFactorization.solve_transposed` replaced by such a double: `REFUSED`, `[LINEAR_SOLVE_FAILED]`, Q3 `pass` (it needs only the forward solve), values `null`. (c) Mode `forward` with the same transpo…

M03 spec §11, A45: Non-square reduced system (§3.3). The linear toy at δ = 1 on a host that declares row `R2` eliminated (1 kept row, 2 variables): `REFUSED`, refusals exactly `[UNSUPPORTED_RANK_STRUCTURE]`; Q2 `fail` with detail `reduced_shape = "1x2"` and no `RegularityEvidence`; Q3 `not_evaluated`; values `null` (*measured* so at `5cf4160`).

M03 spec §11, A46: Estimator non-convergence (§7.3). FIT-I with the pinned `max_nfev` overridden to 2 in the test (*measured*: the registered fit needs 8 residual evaluations, so `least_squares` returns status 0): `FAILED`, stage `estimator`, codes `[ESTIMATOR_NOT_CONVERGED]`. The recorded estimator status is 0, and the last iterate is recorded. There are no estimates, standard errors, covariance, identifiability verdict or predictions.

M03 spec §11, A47: Optimization status precedence (§8.5), on the pure classification and aggregation function, with synthetic per-start inputs (no Ipopt). Each row is a list of starts `(Ipopt status, V1–V5 all pass)` → the start classifications → the report status; `K`, `NV`, `IR`, `SF` abbreviate `KKT_POINT_VERIFIED`, `NOT_VERIFIED`, `INFEASIBLE_REPORTED`, `SOLVER_FAILED`:

M03 spec §11, A48: Schema registry (§10, WO-9). `schemas/registry.json` is sorted and duplicate-free. It equals the set of `schemas/*.schema.json`, the file names of `published_schemas()`'s `$id`s, and the packaged schema names. It contains `study.schema.json` and `optimization-report.schema.json`. `tests/test_t08_w4_package_data.py` contains no literal schema count.
`./scripts/check.sh` green at C: ruff, ruff format, mypy and the default pytest gate, which holds every M03 assertion but A35-A40.

limitations: N1 is pending. The `nlp` extra (91537b0) and the licence acceptance NLP_LICENCES_ACCEPTED (2b6e350) are provisional, and A35-A40 rest on them; the M03.N1 check says so. Declining is the revert of both commits and a re-taken inventory, after which A35-A40 are recorded unsupported (the review's BLOCKED) and optimize() reports UNSUPPORTED everywhere.

The default gate was run on one x86-64 machine. M03 review F1's acceptance, both registered CI runners green, is not established here; the M03.ci_both_runners check says so. The fixture comparison was shown to tolerate cross-platform noise by regenerating every fixture with each linear back-solve perturbed by 1-64 ulps, not on aarch64.

The NLP evidence (A35-A41) is valid only in the audited environment on its host and under OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 (review ruling Q2): each report records its thread configuration and the loaded ASL (review F2), and the adapter enforces nothing. Whether single-threading is a product requirement is open for Frank (ADR 0007 D6).

W24 is a gate id that the manifest schema's `requirements` pattern ([DA]nn) cannot carry. This evidence bears on W24's M03 part (fixed-topology optimization); M05 supplies the trust-region half, and the gate's verdict is the verdict lane's.

Synthetic only: SYN-001 is a synthetic flowsheet, and the estimation data are generated from the model itself, so FIT-I and FIT-U are numerical verification of the estimation machinery, not empirical validation.
Local stationarity is not global optimality. NLP-1's candidate is a verified KKT point from three starts; second-order conditions are not assessed (limited-memory Hessian, spec §8.3).

The fixture comparison's rules for values T08-numerical-policy-v2 has no row for (the scaled-sensitivity floor tau_abs = 1e-11 among them) live in tests/m03_fixture_compare.py, not in the registered policy data; the design lane registers them (review F1).

Review notes left open: F6 (one CasADi Function for [F_x F_p]; caching the twin, for M05), F8.2 (the formulation record states the first verified start's regimes), F8.3 (Q0 is structurally vacuous in syn001_sensitivity) and F8.4 (tp_margin assumes ideal, composition-independent K; a non-ideal host needs a new margin).
Human numerical and process-modeling review remain `pending`; `reviewed` is never self-set.
